summary_points: Rotary Triple Offset Control Valve specification for the Solana project
Initialing required on cover sheet only, revisions in body of Specification
Contract allows alternate billing cycles upon request
Confidentiality notice regarding proprietary information
Supplier responsible for delivery to selected Fabricator(s) and/or jobsite
Rotary Triple Offset Control Valve specification for Thermal Energy Storage Area
All materials must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards
Monthly shipping of 1 set of valves starting December 2011
A list of recommended spare parts is required with prices and delivery details
Equipment must be inspected by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment
Confidentiality terms apply to the information provided
The valve is a rotary triple offset control valve with a design capacity of up to 4,426,140 lbm/hr.
It operates in a hazardous area classified as Class 1, Division 2, Group D.
The valve features an integral arrow indicating the direction of flow and a modulating function.
The actuator type is piston-spring loaded with a travel range of 0.78%.
Communication is facilitated through HART protocol with I/O analog signals ranging from 4-20mA DC.
The valve is a rotary triple offset control valve with a tag of FV 2-251-35 and service as Discharge Mode HTF Flow Control Valve - TES-2.
It operates under normal conditions with a flow rate of 4,023,763 lbm/hr and an inlet pressure of 302.9 psia.
The valve has a body size of 20" and is rated for Class 600.
It features a modulating function with on-off capability set to No.
The actuator type is Piston - Spring Loaded, manufactured by Tyco-Biffi under the Algas model.
The valve is a Rotary Triple Offset Control Valve with tag FV 3-251-35 and service as Discharge Mode HTF Flow Control Valve - TES-3.
Process conditions include flow, inlet pressure, outlet pressure, temperature, density, viscosity, vapour pressure, and flow coefficient Cv.
Valve specifications detail size, actuator type, manufacturer, and model.

Design considerations include warm-up mode requirements, vendor information, integral arrow for direction of flow, stem travel scale, installation orientation restrictions, and maximum flow handling capacity.
The valve is a Rotary Triple Offset Control Valve with a tag of FV 4-251-35 and service as Discharge Mode HTF Flow Control Valve - TES-4.
The valve is manufactured by Tyco-Biffi with model Algas and has a body material of A216 Gr. WCB.
It features a modulating function, instrument air supply of 60-80 psig, and communication via HART protocol.
The actuator type is Piston - Spring Loaded, and it has an action of closing on control signal failure.
The valve is a Rotary Triple Offset Control Valve with a tag of FV 5-251-35 and service as Discharge Mode HTF Flow Control Valve - TES-5.
The valve has an actuator type of Piston - Spring Loaded, manufactured by Tyco-Biffi with model Algas.
Design specifications include insulation, body and bonnet type, instrument air supply, communication, I/O analog signals, and more.
Notes emphasize the importance of warm-up mode, vendor information requirements, valve installation orientation, and handling high flow rates.
Two rotary triple offset control valves for HTF flow control in TES area.
Valves FV 6-251-35 and FV 1-251-36 with different specifications.
Both valves have a design pressure of 400 psig and 300 psig respectively.
Flow coefficients Cv are 396 for FV 6-251-35 and 394 for FV 1-251-36.
Valves are modulating with on-off functionality disabled.
Both valves require an instrument air supply of 60-80 psig.
Communication protocol is HART, and I/O signals are 4-20mA DC.
